_comment: Boards the pump serves; copy to boards.json and edit by hand.
Each board needs name, repo (the repo top level; cards in .deviz/tasks/ or cards_dir),
"pump2": true (boards without it are skipped) and a test command
(pump2_test, or test): merge and pump2 doctor refuse a board without one.
Every other key is optional; the full table is in docs/pump.md.
me: this install's name on shared boards: authors are stamped
<me>/<profile>, the pump takes only cards assigned to this install (or
unassigned); unset = single-install mode, every card is taken.
me_aliases: bare assignee names that also mean this install (legacy
names that are not profiles, e.g. user, owner, claude).
design.kit: optional list of up to 6 UI kit images in the board repo,
attached first to the design critic and named to the designer (docs/pump-v2.md).
design.components: optional list of up to 12 paths / globs of kit component files;
the builder prompt lists their exported components, read from the code.
design.style_spec / design.mockups / design.threshold: optional mockup mode.
style_spec: the board's style spec YAML (approved via pump2 design spec seed|approve);
mockups: {preset: best|quality|fast, count: 3..4} turns on step 0 (free FLUX mockups,
key-store service flux); threshold 5..9 (default 7): the lowest dimension a ready render needs.
Example design block: {"render": [...], "gate": [...], "python": "...",
"style_spec": "docs/style-spec.yaml", "mockups": {"preset": "best", "count": 4}, "threshold": 7}
